SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

3. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat The School as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

5. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

6. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

9. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   C. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.

10. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)

   B. Nakuru

   D. Mombasa

13. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.

14. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
